# permio_role (Resource)

A role: a named set of permissions. Grant a role to a principal with `permio_grant`, using the role's `id`.

Role names are unique across the whole organisation, not just the project. A role can be renamed in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "permio_permission" "read" {
  name = "document.read"
}

resource "permio_permission" "write" {
  name = "document.write"
}

resource "permio_role" "editor" {
  name        = "Document editor"
  description = "Reads and edits documents"
  permissions = [
    permio_permission.read.name,
    permio_permission.write.name,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name: 1 to 128 characters, no control characters. Unique in the organisation.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Names of the permissions in the role. A role needs at least one permission, and every permission must exist in the project.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the role.
- `project` (String) Project the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the object. API keys are scoped to one project, so this must be the key's project.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Role ID assigned by Permio. Grants refer to roles by this ID.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A role can be imported by "<project>/<role ID>" or "<project>/<role name>", or without the project prefix
# for the provider's project. Role names that contain "/" must use the "<project>/<name>" form.
terraform import permio_role.editor default/2f6c1d1e-6a4b-4c8f-9d55-0c1f3f6b7a10
terraform import permio_role.editor "default/Document editor"
```
